parsed.degree_signal: PhD in robotics, mechanical engineering, applied mathematics, physics, computer graphics or a related field, or a Masters + 3 years of experience. Exceptional candidates with a bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of relevant industry experience are also welcome to apply.
parsed.notes:
Who You Are and Minimum Qualifications supply required candidate skills; Preferred Qualifications supplies optional skills. Your Next Challenge is a responsibilities section, not a dedicated tech-stack section, so technologies and practices appearing only there are excluded.
Rigid-body dynamics and constrained multibody systems are treated as domain knowledge, while explicitly named implementation, modelling, integration and simulation techniques are included as unmapped skills.
The taxonomy lacks most robotics simulation tools and techniques. MuJoCo, Newton/Warp, PhysX, Drake, Bullet and Genesis are examples for a single implementation-experience ask, constituting alternative set 1; these cannot be encoded as expected criteria without inventing taxonomy IDs. CUDA, NVIDIA Warp and JAX form set 2; NVIDIA Warp is unmapped. Other alternatives involving unmapped skills likewise cannot be fully represented in expected.
Newton/Warp is retained literally rather than silently resolving the slash into separate products. NVIDIA Warp is separately named in the preferred section; its overlap with Newton/Warp requires taxonomy resolution.
The generic word reinforcement in 'reinforcement or imitation learning' is read as reinforcement learning. Its alternative, imitation learning, is unmapped; no singleton alternative_group is emitted.
The mapped CUDA and JAX skills and all unmapped skills beginning with GPU programming for physics through contact-rich robotic tasks are preferred, except source-level simulation stack knowledge, which is required. NVIDIA Warp's optional mention may overlap the required Newton/Warp example.
The highest named degree is PhD despite the accepted master's and bachelor's routes. Every route still requires a degree, so degree_or_equivalent is false.
Seniority is inferred from the explicit three-year experience route, not from technical depth. No German-language requirement is stated.
